# pattern <name> <index of the first judgement applied with FailedAtJudgement set, or -1>: names are perfect (every MaxResult), allmiss (every MinResult), random-<p> (MaxResult with probability p, else a random lower result), failed-<k> (random-0.7 results, failed from judgement k), unit-ok and unit-meh (a single circle, lazer's ScoreProcessorTest.TestSingleOsuHit)
